Model
NSG3060 
The Teseq NSG3060 Surge Generator is a modular, multifunction conducted immunity system designed for advanced EMC testing. With surge voltages up to 6.6 kV, a 7” intuitive touchscreen, and support for IEC/EN and ANSI coupling methods, it provides high accuracy switching and versatile performance. Its modular design allows easy configuration for standards like IEC/EN 61000-4-4, 61000-4-5, 61000-4-8, and ANSI C62.41, ensuring compliance and scalability.
Engineered for both basic CE mark testing and complex laboratory applications, the NSG3060 offers direct test access (DTA), real-time parameter adjustments, and compatibility with a wide range of test accessories. Expansion modules can be integrated quickly, ensuring laboratories can meet evolving testing requirements with efficiency.
Testwall can supply the used Teseq NSG3060, fully tested. With expert support and global delivery, Testwall ensures high-performance instrumentation with unmatched reliability and service quality. Please contact us directly if you need calibration or repair of the Teseq NSG3060.
